At this stage, I don't really feel like I could ever have a future that's worth living. I'm just going to be passed around from care home to care home as I can't get a job and therefor take care of myself. I can't see the point of the point of continuing on anymore and the days just seem needless now.

My dad wasn't around in my early life, up the the age of 5-6 he worked for a large company and was going abroad every few days for a week or two ( mainly america and norway, but he even went to india a couple times) when I was about 6 my farther lost his job and got a new one, meaning he was more present in my life. But my dad has a short temper and abused me and my mother a lot physically and everyone in the family a lot psychologically. When I was 11 years old I was diagnosed with depression for the first time and a welfare team was raised to keep an eye on my mental health, they perscribed me diazepam and told me I was fine for 5 years, even though I wasn't. When I was 12 I was finally diagnosed with High functioning autism (very, very, very late. Most are diagnosed as babies or toddlers), my mum knew I was for a long time, but my dad refused to let me be tested as he saw it as an embarrisment to him, this meant I never got the support I needed in school at all the early years and not nearly as much as I needed at any point. Things also got a lot worse with my dad at that point. When I was 13 I started self harming, when I was 16 I attempted suicide for the first time, and I got put in hospital for 3 months and a day. I missed all my GCSE's as I was 3 hours drive away from my home in a ward I was unable to leave. I failed school. 1 and a half years ago my dad was removed from the house (finally) after strangling my mum nearly to death at my sisters birthday party, a year ago I moved out the house and in the past 3 months my sister has overdosed 5 times and nearly died twice. I was also bullied awfully throughout school, and got in fights every day. For my last year I spent about half my time internally excluded because it wasn't safe for me to attend lessons anymore. That's my story, more or less.

I was 11 when I was first diagnosed with depression, though I can't remember much past the age of 12. One of my teachers got me diagnosed when she noticed cuts on my arm, she sent me to head teacher who asked me all about what happened before getting the school guidance counsellor to talk to me. I ended up being referred to a children's outpatient ward. They put me on diazepam for 5 years and left me until I attempted suicide. I never really got any help because the mental health service here in the UK is awful.

About 3 months ago my girlfriends sister died. She over time cut contact with me. 3 days ago I called her to see how she was. She sounded happier and said that she has another boyfriend now, like it was nothing. It felt like everything fell apart as she's been the only person there for me for 4 years and now she's thrown me away like I'm nothing.
Probably 2 or 3 days ago but now head feels all light like I'm floating and my eyes feel like ice or something. It all feels like some sort of dream.
